mainEntity.name: Do my files leave my device when I convert with Shifteo?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. All processing happens locally in your browser and files never leave your device.

mainEntity.name: Which image formats can I convert?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shifteo converts PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF and more with quality and resize controls.
